title: 312 福利番外进坟311 番外六 回部落
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：一听这话，所有人面色均一片死灰。
不过，更多的人则是将目光投向我来。
显而易见，目前唯一的希望就是我了。
落坤不愧是活了万年的古蛇，虽然没见过龙野，但竟是隐约猜到了后者的一些想法。
但这几个地方到来的生灵着实有不少修为高深之辈，让敖广喜出望外，特别是北海之地，这北海为混乱之地，根本没有服众的万古大派镇压，北海生灵皆是在战火中成长起来的，全是好勇斗狠、心性狠辣之辈，极善争斗。
一转眼，便到了第二天早上。
在所有人的瞩目中，我坐上了道术协会给我配的专车，前往拍卖现场。
一路上，道术协会的那些道人简直都是瞠目结舌。
结果，令我吃惊的一幕果然出现了。
那老太婆手中的那个破碗，仿佛是金刚不坏一般。
就在我血剑一剑斩落到她头顶的瞬间，她将这个破碗举了起来，然后铿锵一声过后，血剑居然就被阻挡了下来。
“爸，锦鹏因此付出了生命代价，这个教训，我也记住了……”
任国辉垂头丧气地说道。
而要想成就出游圆满境界，就得一次次让阴神白日显形，经受太阳真火淬炼，一点点磨练自家阴神，直到阴神转变纯阳，再也不惧太阳真火，可在烈日下自由自在活动时，才成出游圆满境界。
李凉渲轻轻点头，然后不再理我。
可是，此时无论可嫣她们怎么说，我们毕竟都走到这里来了，此时问到一股妖气，如果不看个究竟，这心里头就实在是有点不舒服了。
这种将人周身血液抽空的手段，极为诡异，跟血河道人的神通手段有几分相似之处。
分别是一年B班的班主任跟副主任，其中世界是作为班主任，源流志宏是副主任。
因为陈威和陈落落还没来，这几个孩子才敢过来靠近三胞胎，之前都没敢靠近他们。
三天三夜的炼制，夜羽汐双眼已经布满血丝，脸颊也透着几分惨白，这完全是精神力接近枯竭的症状。

洛云汐望着门外，随后轻轻一笑，关了门，进了莲境空间修炼去了。
不远处的一桌人见到这边的景象，顿时有一人不屑的哼了一声，其他人也是面带讥笑，一脸看好戏的神情。
“你惩罚我的方式，依然是在惩罚自己。”
她带着他的手，往她的敏感部位移去。
两人零距离的躺在一起，这使得安静的室内透出一种温馨而甜蜜的氛围。
“住口！”
content_en:
: Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions turned pale.
However, more people turned their attention to me.
It was obvious that the only hope at the moment was me.
Luo Kun was worthy of being an ancient snake that had lived for ten thousand years. Although he had never met Long Ye, he vaguely guessed some of the latter's thoughts.
But Ao Guang was overjoyed that many of the creatures arriving from these places had advanced cultivations, especially the land of Beihai. This was a place of chaos, and there was no suppression by the ever-conquering Eternal Great Sect. The creatures in Beihai grew up in the flames of war. They were all brave, ruthless, and ruthless people who were extremely good at fighting.
In a blink of an eye, it was the next morning.
Under everyone's attention, I got into the special car assigned to me by the Taoist Association and headed to the auction site.
Along the way, the Taoists from the Taoist Association were simply dumbfounded.
As a result, a scene that surprised me really happened.
The broken bowl in the old woman's hand seemed to be indestructible.
The moment my blood sword struck her head, she raised the broken bowl, and with a clang, the blood sword was actually blocked.
"Dad, Jinpeng paid the price with his life. I have also remembered this lesson..."
Ren Guohui said dejectedly.
And if you want to achieve the perfect state of traveling, you have to let the Yin God appear in the day time and again, and be tempered by the true fire of the sun, and temper your own Yin God little by little, until the Yin God transforms into a pure Yang, no longer afraid of the true fire of the sun, and can move freely under the scorching sun, then you can achieve the perfect state of traveling.
Li Liangxuan nodded slightly and then ignored me.
However, no matter what Keyan and the others say at this time, we have all come here after all. If we ask about a demonic aura at this time, if we don't see what happens, we will really feel a little uncomfortable.
This method of draining blood from a person's body is extremely strange, and is somewhat similar to the magical method of the Blood River Taoist.
They are the head teacher and deputy head teacher of Class B in the first year, with Sekai as the head teacher and Genryu Shihiro as the deputy head teacher.
Because Chen Wei and Chen Luoluo hadn't arrived yet, these children dared to come close to the triplets. They had not dared to approach them before.
After three days and three nights of refining, Ye Yuxi's eyes were already bloodshot and her cheeks were a bit pale. This was completely a symptom of near-depletion of mental energy.
Luo Yunxi looked outside the door, then smiled softly, closed the door, and entered the Lotus Realm space to practice.
When people at a table not far away saw the scene here, one person immediately snorted disdainfully, and the others also had sneers on their faces, looking like they were watching a good show.
"The way you punish me is still punishing yourself."
She took his hand and moved it to her sensitive parts.
The two of them lay close together, which gave the quiet room a warm and sweet atmosphere.
"shut up!"
